master_plan_principles_consumed.principle_text: AtomicRows is parameter inventory, not a trader or source of live authority.
QTT rejects fragile single-parameter or single-algorithm configurations.
Required stack roles must include SIGNAL, SCORING, NORMALIZATION, RISK, EXECUTION, CAPITAL, LATENCY, ERROR_GUARD, and repo-required QUANTUM_ADVISORY.
Blocked, source-missing, negative, unknown, owner-pending, rejected, or dormant rows are removed or visible only as blocked metadata.
Generate multiple candidate stacks when available before concurrent replay/paper competition.
Quantum may rank or refine candidate stack ordering but cannot turn AtomicRows inventory into direct live order authority; classical gates remain final for execution release.

Codex, ChatGPT, and the compiler must not invent external source claims, optimizer defaults, broker or venue semantics, quantum backend parameters, true-quantum circuit parameters, shot options, or primitive options.
